description: Zero-cost schedule leftover from 37-epoch runs, re-posed on the Muon tip. At 8.75 ep, whiten_bias_epochs 3 trains the whitening bias for about 34% of the run. On tip E031, first confirm in the code that a whitening-bias phase exists and what its semantics are. If it does not exist, record a no-op and do not run. Otherwise change only whiten_bias_epochs, from 3 to 1 (scaled about 3/37 x 8.75 ≈ 0.7, rounded up).
